title: Toy conduction rule
content: At fixed conductivity, area and temperature difference, doubling thickness halves noiseless heat flow.

title: Fixed boundaries
content: This model keeps the temperature difference constant and ignores air leaks.

title: Contrasting toy observation
content: In a fictional leaky room, extra insulation did not halve total heat loss because air leakage dominated.

title: Noise note
content: Synthetic measurement noise varies within a fixed bounded fraction of the noiseless prediction.

title: Unrelated color survey
content: A fictional survey preferred blue notebook covers. It provides no evidence about heat transfer.
